22/**
23 * Encapsulates a Character Set ECI, according to "Extended Channel Interpretations" 5.3.1.1
24 * of ISO 18004.
25 *
26 * @author Sean Owen
27 */
28#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Clone, Copy)]
29pub enum CharacterSet {
30    // Enum name is a Java encoding valid for java.lang and java.io
31    Cp437,      //(new int[]{0,2}),
32    ISO8859_1,  //(new int[]{1,3}, "ISO-8859-1"),
33    ISO8859_2,  //(4, "ISO-8859-2"),
34    ISO8859_3,  //(5, "ISO-8859-3"),
35    ISO8859_4,  //(6, "ISO-8859-4"),
36    ISO8859_5,  //(7, "ISO-8859-5"),
37    ISO8859_6,  //(8, "ISO-8859-6"),
38    ISO8859_7,  //(9, "ISO-8859-7"),
39    ISO8859_8,  //(10, "ISO-8859-8"),
40    ISO8859_9,  //(11, "ISO-8859-9"),
41    ISO8859_10, //(12, "ISO-8859-10"),
42    ISO8859_11, //(13, "ISO-8859-11"),
43    ISO8859_13, //(15, "ISO-8859-13"),
44    ISO8859_14, //(16, "ISO-8859-14"),
45    ISO8859_15, //(17, "ISO-8859-15"),
46    ISO8859_16, //(18, "ISO-8859-16"),
47    Shift_JIS,  //(20, "Shift_JIS"),
48    Cp1250,     //(21, "windows-1250"),
49    Cp1251,     //(22, "windows-1251"),
50    Cp1252,     //(23, "windows-1252"),
51    Cp1256,     //(24, "windows-1256"),
52    UTF16BE,    //(25, "UTF-16BE", "UnicodeBig"),
53    UTF8,       //(26, "UTF-8"),
54    ASCII,      //(new int[] {27, 170}, "US-ASCII"),
55    Big5,       //(28),
56    GB2312,
57    GB18030, //(29, "GB2312", "EUC_CN", "GBK"),
58    EUC_KR,  //(30, "EUC-KR");
59    UTF16LE,
60    UTF32BE,
61    UTF32LE,
62    Binary,
63    Unknown,
64}

104    fn get_base_encoder(&self) -> EncodingRef {
105        let name = match self {
106            CharacterSet::Cp437 => "cp437",
107            CharacterSet::ISO8859_1 => return encoding::all::ISO_8859_1,
108            CharacterSet::ISO8859_2 => "ISO-8859-2",
109            CharacterSet::ISO8859_3 => "ISO-8859-3",
110            CharacterSet::ISO8859_4 => "ISO-8859-4",
111            CharacterSet::ISO8859_5 => "ISO-8859-5",
112            CharacterSet::ISO8859_6 => "ISO-8859-6",
113            CharacterSet::ISO8859_7 => "ISO-8859-7",
114            CharacterSet::ISO8859_8 => "ISO-8859-8",
115            CharacterSet::ISO8859_9 => "ISO-8859-9",
116            CharacterSet::ISO8859_10 => "ISO-8859-10",
117            CharacterSet::ISO8859_11 => "ISO-8859-11",
118            CharacterSet::ISO8859_13 => "ISO-8859-13",
119            CharacterSet::ISO8859_14 => "ISO-8859-14",
120            CharacterSet::ISO8859_15 => "ISO-8859-15",
121            CharacterSet::ISO8859_16 => "ISO-8859-16",
122            CharacterSet::Shift_JIS => "shift_jis",
123            CharacterSet::Cp1250 => "windows-1250",
124            CharacterSet::Cp1251 => "windows-1251",
125            CharacterSet::Cp1252 => "windows-1252",
126            CharacterSet::Cp1256 => "windows-1256",
127            CharacterSet::UTF16BE => "UTF-16BE",
128            CharacterSet::UTF16LE => "UTF-16LE",
129            CharacterSet::UTF8 => "UTF-8",
130            CharacterSet::ASCII => "US-ASCII",
131            CharacterSet::Big5 => "Big5",
132            CharacterSet::GB18030 => "GB18030",
133            CharacterSet::GB2312 => "GB2312",
134            CharacterSet::EUC_KR => "EUC-KR",
135            CharacterSet::UTF32BE => "utf-32be",
136            CharacterSet::UTF32LE => "utf-32le",
137            CharacterSet::Binary => "binary",
138            CharacterSet::Unknown => "unknown",
139        };
140        encoding::label::encoding_from_whatwg_label(name).unwrap()
141    }

268    /**
269     * @param name character set ECI encoding name
270     * @return CharacterSetECI representing ECI for character encoding, or null if it is legal
271     *   but unsupported
272     */
273    pub fn get_character_set_by_name(name: &str) -> Option<CharacterSet> {
274        match name.to_lowercase().as_str() {
275            "cp437" => Some(CharacterSet::Cp437),
276            "iso-8859-1" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_1),
277            "iso-8859-2" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_2),
278            "iso-8859-3" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_3),
279            "iso-8859-4" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_4),
280            "iso-8859-5" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_5),
281            // "iso-8859-6" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_6),
282            "iso-8859-7" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_7),
283            // "iso-8859-8" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_8),
284            "iso-8859-9" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_9),
285            // "ISO-8859-10" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_10),
286            // "ISO-8859-11" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_11),
287            "iso-8859-13" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_13),
288            // "ISO-8859-14" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_14),
289            "iso-8859-15" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_15),
290            "iso-8859-16" => Some(CharacterSet::ISO8859_16),
291            "shift_jis" => Some(CharacterSet::Shift_JIS),
292            "windows-1250" => Some(CharacterSet::Cp1250),
293            "windows-1251" => Some(CharacterSet::Cp1251),
294            "windows-1252" => Some(CharacterSet::Cp1252),
295            "windows-1256" => Some(CharacterSet::Cp1256),
296            "utf-16be" => Some(CharacterSet::UTF16BE),
297            "utf-8" | "utf8" => Some(CharacterSet::UTF8),
298            "us-ascii" => Some(CharacterSet::ASCII),
299            "big5" => Some(CharacterSet::Big5),
300            "gb2312" => Some(CharacterSet::GB2312),
301            "gb18030" => Some(CharacterSet::GB18030),
302            "euc-kr" => Some(CharacterSet::EUC_KR),
303            "utf-32be" => Some(CharacterSet::UTF32BE),
304            "utf-32le" => Some(CharacterSet::UTF32LE),
305            "binary" => Some(CharacterSet::Binary),
306            "unknown" => Some(CharacterSet::Unknown),
307            _ => None,
308        }
309    }

311    pub fn encode(&self, input: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
312        if self == &CharacterSet::Cp437 {
313            use codepage_437::ToCp437;
314            use codepage_437::CP437_CONTROL;
315
316            input
317                .to_cp437(&CP437_CONTROL)
318                .map(|data| data.to_vec())
319                .map_err(|e| Exceptions::format_with(format!("{e:?}")))
320        } else {
321            self.get_base_encoder()
322                .encode(input, encoding::EncoderTrap::Strict)
323                .map_err(|e| Exceptions::format_with(e.to_string()))
324        }
325    }
326
327    pub fn encode_replace(&self, input: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
328        self.get_base_encoder()
329            .encode(input, encoding::EncoderTrap::Replace)
330            .map_err(|e| Exceptions::format_with(e.to_string()))
331    }
332
333    pub fn decode(&self, input: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {
334        if self == &CharacterSet::Cp437 {
335            use codepage_437::BorrowFromCp437;
336            use codepage_437::CP437_CONTROL;
337
338            Ok(String::borrow_from_cp437(&input, &CP437_CONTROL))
339        } else {
340            self.get_base_encoder()
341                .decode(input, encoding::DecoderTrap::Strict)
342                .map_err(|e| Exceptions::format_with(e.to_string()))
343        }
344    }
345
346    pub fn decode_replace(&self, input: &[u8]) -> Result<String> {
347        self.get_base_encoder()
348            .decode(input, encoding::DecoderTrap::Replace)
349            .map_err(|e| Exceptions::format_with(e.to_string()))
350    }
